items.title: Groupe Renaissance du Nord supports young athletes
items.text:
On Wednesday 15 July 2026, the Annual Sports Day Prize-Giving Ceremony of St François Xavier RCA School was held at the Germain Commarmond Stadium in Bambous.
Groupe Renaissance du Nord was represented by its Executive Vice-President, Mr Sunilduth Sohun. The Group also generously sponsored 150 medals to reward the pupils for their participation and achievements.
Groupe Renaissance du Nord congratulates all the young athletes and commends the school for promoting discipline, teamwork and sportsmanship.

items.title: Prostate Cancer Awareness & PSA Testing Session
items.text:
Groupe Renaissance du Nord conducted a special awareness session on prostate cancer and PSA testing in collaboration with Absa Mauritius, as part of their Stories of Hope campaign. The event was a meaningful success for the community.
We extend our sincere thanks to Absa Mauritius for their strong commitment to men’s health, to Link to Life for their expertise and continuous support, and to our medical team, volunteers, and participants for contributing to the success of this initiative.
Together, we continue to promote early detection and encourage men to take charge of their health.

items.title: Launch of Floating Wheelchair – Accessibility and Inclusion
items.text:
Groupe Renaissance du Nord extends its sincere thanks to all public, private, and state institutions for supporting this meaningful initiative. A floating wheelchair has been introduced to allow children with special needs to access the sea safely.
The event highlighted the importance of inclusion, beach accessibility, and the therapeutic benefits of seawater. The service will also be available at St Félix, Belle Mare, and Mont Choisy, with prior registration required to ensure user safety.

items.title: Special Day for Our Senior Citizens
items.text:
The Association Solidarité Mauriciens d’Ailleurs and Groupe Renaissance du Nord organised a Special Day for senior citizens at the Multiple Complex Hall in Plaine des Papayes. The event brought together over 300 elderly participants for a joyful moment filled with music, shared laughter, and warm interaction.
We extend our sincere appreciation to all partners, sponsors, local authorities, service providers, and community supporters who contributed to the success of this gathering. We also thank the religious representatives who offered blessings and messages of wisdom, adding a meaningful spiritual dimension to the day.
Our gratitude also goes to the artists and performers who helped create a lively and memorable atmosphere.
Above all, we thank our senior citizens for their presence and enthusiasm, which made this celebration truly special.

items.title: Protecting Our Dharma and Environment – A Noble Initiative
items.text:
Groupe Renaissance du Nord, in collaboration with Shri Srinivasa Aalayam and Hindu Maha Sabha, is committed to preserving both sacred traditions and the environment. This initiative raises awareness on the respectful and environmentally responsible disposal of murtis.
A proposed solution is the construction of a Gowshala, providing a sacred and sustainable space that aligns faith with environmental protection. The campaign calls on Hindu priests, associations, and the wider community to support this effort, while also encouraging government action to regulate murti disposal and safeguard natural sites.
Together, we can uphold our Dharma while protecting the environment.

items.title: Père Laval Pilgrimage – Welcoming Devotees
items.text:
Groupe Renaissance du Nord was present at Hochet, Terre Rouge, to welcome all pilgrims of the Blessed Père Laval. As every year, the group supports and accompanies the thousands of devotees who walk in faith and gratitude to the shrine of Père Laval—one of the most important spiritual pilgrimages in Mauritius.
This annual gathering honours Père Laval’s legacy of compassion and unity, and brings together people from all communities in a moment of prayer, reflection, and solidarity.

items.title: 40 Hours Devotion – Support to Pilgrims
items.text:
On the occasion of the 40 Hours devotion, Groupe Renaissance du Nord joined the Grotto Chapel Notre-Dame de Grand Pouvoir in Cap Malheureux for a moment of sharing and solidarity. In a spirit of service, the team offered refreshments to pilgrims, providing comfort along their journey of prayer.
This initiative reflects our commitment to community support, unity, and mutual care, reminding us that acts of service strengthen the bonds that hold us together.
Groupe Renaissance du Nord remains dedicated to fostering fraternity and supporting all who walk this path of faith and reflection.

items.title: “Drop a Book, Take a Book” Collaboration
items.text: Groupe Renaissance du Nord extends its appreciation to the University of the Third Age of Baie du Tombeau for their collaboration on the “Drop a Book, Take a Book” project in the village. A special thank-you goes to Mr. Armoogum Parsooraman for his valuable support.

items.title: Heartfelt Thanks and Encouragement for Our Amazing Team
items.text:
Dear Team,
We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your presence at today’s meeting. Your motivation, enthusiasm, and willingness to share and support each other are truly inspiring.
To those who couldn't join us today, we felt your spirit and send our blessings and love your way. Together, we are stronger, and we are confident that our collaboration will continue to thrive.
Let’s keep pushing forward with the same energy and dedication.
God bless our entire All Together Team.

items.title: Tree-Planting Activity
items.text: Groupe Renaissance du Nord partnered with youth from Domaine du Moulin, Goodlands, to plant 100 saplings as part of the Independence Day Celebration in honour of Mauritius’ national day. The initiative was made possible thanks to the support of the District Council of Rivière du Rempart, Bois de Forest, the villagers of Goodlands, Ronit Karaoke, Ramsurrun Commercial Centre, Srinivasa Aalayam Goodlands, and the All Together Team. The activity strengthened community engagement and environmental awareness, with coordination and scripting led by Briz Ramsurrun.
